Package com.lemarketjames.market.client

Class MarketDataClient

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.market.client.MarketDataClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
MarketDataService
@Service public class MarketDataClient extends Object implements MarketDataService
MarketDataService over HTTP, reached at market-service's /api/market/**. Since market prices are non-critical read data, a failed or slow call degrades to "no quote" (empty/404) rather than throwing, matching how callers already treated an unsimulated instrument before this feature was ever a separate service (see HoldingsService's zero-valued fallback).
